notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
The free demo of WorldShaper Idle has been updated with the following new features:
[list]
[*] You can now save up to five builds and switch between them
[*] You can now see how to build tiles in the tile journal
[*] The smugglers' port has been rebalanced to be less overpowered
[*] A "Tile Count" button has been added to the tile journal
[/list]
If you enjoy the demo, please [b]wishlist the game[/b] to support it and get a notification when it's released! Thanks!

notes.title: Free Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
A free demo of WorldShaper Idle is now available! This demo allows you to try a lot of the content of the full game ahead of its release.

Try the demo by clicking the big green Download button on the store page!

The demo differs from the upcoming full version in the following ways:
[list]
[*] The full version allows you to grow your world as often as you can afford (the demo allows you to grow it three times)
[*] The full version will allow you to unlock more types of tiles from the mid game
[*] The full version unlocks the Elves as a new tile set. They have fully new tiles and bonuses to discover, and you will be able to have an Elves world next to your Humans world.
[/list]

Thanks for trying the demo. Your feedback is always welcome in the Steam forums or [url=https://florianvanstrien.nl/discord.php]my Discord[/url]!
